name: Xperia XZs

images.credit: April.Kai, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Launch.Predecessor: Sony Xperia XZ, Sony Xperia X Performance

Body.Dimensions: 146 mm H, 72 mm W, 8.1 mm D

Platform.CPU: Quad-core (dual 2.15 GHz + dual 1.6 GHz) 64-bit Kryo processor

Display.Display: 5.2 in 1080p IPS LCD, Full HD 1920x1080 px TRILUMINOS Display for mobile with X-Reality for mobile, Dynamic Contrast Enhancement, sRGB 138%

Cameras.Rear camera: 19 MP Motion Eye™ Camera, 1/2.3 memory-stacked Exmor RS for mobile sensor (1.22μm), BIONZ, RGBC-IR, Laser AF, Predictive Hybrid AF, Predictive Capture, Quick launch, 5x Clear Image Zoom, 25mm Wide Angle G Lens, f/2.0 , 4K (2160p) video recording, 720p 960 fps super slow motion videos, SteadyShot with Intelligent Active Mode (5-axis stabilization)
Cameras.Front camera: 13 MP 1/3.06 Exmor RS for mobile sensor, with Quick launch and 22mm Wide Angle Lens and f/2.0 aperture, SteadyShot with Intelligent Active Mode (5-axis stabilization)

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi, DLNA, GPS/GLONASS/BeiDou, Bluetooth 4.2, USB 2.0 (Type-C port, USB charging, Quick Charge 3.0)
